newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes higher led by major issues.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes higher led by major issues.

text.p: Czech major issues rebounded on Monday led by a rare bout of foreign buying which pushed the PX50 index up 1.25 percent to 509.5.
"I think that the price changes are thanks to some foreign orders," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka.
SPT Telecom the most heavily capitalised share led the pack with an 89 crown, 2.9 percent, jump to 3,150.
Kusacek said that all the blue chip gainers, and especially SPT, were beginning to attract greater interest because of their cheapness relative to risk after a period of sustained losses.
Power utility CEZ, long the most vulnerable of the blue chips, also posted solid gains. CEZ rose 32 crowns, 3.5 percent, to 952.
The banking sector was more mixed although Komercni Banka rose 31 crowns, 1.6 percent, to 1,975. Ceska Sporitelna fell three crowns to 293.
Overall, turnover was slightly heavier at 900 million crowns.
